people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.
translations.bsb: Moses then brought the bull near for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translations.kjv: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
translations.asv: And he brought the bullock of the sin-offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock of the sin-offering.
